chunks: He did not believe in God the Supreme.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when someone does not believe in Allah the Great?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the cognitive root of disbelief, where the denial of Allah's 'Greatness' (Al-Azeem) reflects a failure to recognize His absolute sovereignty and magnitude. This specific attribute is often linked to the concept of Tawhid in its comprehensive sense, distinguishing mere belief in existence from the acknowledgment of divine majesty that compels submission.
